images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a retro turn-based strategy game in the style of Heroes of Might and Magic II, 16:9 landscape, full-screen UI, no device frame, no poster framing, no title text. Deliberately low-resolution pixel art, flat limited palette, hard-edged dithering, no 3D rendering, no photographic texture. Left three-quarters: a top-down SQUARE-grid overland map in a muted palette of dusty road ochre, olive grassland, tan hills, dark pine forest, grey-green marsh, slate-blue lake, grey mountains; a central lake ringed by mountains splits the land into four corridors. One teal-cloaked mounted hero token stands on a road tile inside a pale cream translucent reachable-area overlay bounded by a bright ivory outline. A dashed vermillion path leaves that outline toward a gold mine two tiles beyond it, and a red circled X marks the tile where movement runs out. Right quarter: an ornate parchment panel with gold-leaf borders. CRITICAL — the panel must contain EXACTLY these six building plaques and nothing else, no mage guild, no marketplace, no shipyard: "주거 1단", "주거 2단", "주거 3단", "주거 4단", "성벽", "금고". Below them a roster of EXACTLY four unit rows, named top to bottom: "민병", "석궁병", "창기병", "성기사" — no other unit names anywhere. Each row shows small integer stats only. Top bar: "29일째" on the left, "마감 49일" on the right, and gold/wood/ore counters as whole numbers. Bottom bar: a long horizontal meter labelled "이동력 1400", filled teal with a hatched vermillion overflow stub at the far right end, and red text "150 부족". A small vermillion callout plate over the map also reads "150 부족". A single button reads "다음 턴". All on-screen numbers are whole integers with no decimal points. Warm candlelit parchment mood, uncluttered hierarchy, every sprite readable as a silhouette, one coherent palette.

images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a retro turn-based tactical battle in the style of Heroes of Might and Magic III, 16:9 landscape, full-screen UI, no device frame, no poster framing, no title text. Deliberately low-resolution pixel art, flat limited palette, hard-edged dithering, no 3D rendering, no photographic texture. Center-left two-thirds: a SQUARE checkerboard battlefield of alternating olive and moss green tiles framed by an ornate parchment border with gold inlay. Unit stacks are flat readable silhouette sprites on small square plinths — teal plinths on the right for the crown faction, vermillion plinths on the left for the barbarian faction — each with a dark plate underneath showing a whole-number creature count. One wounded stack has a thin gold bar above it. A pale cream overlay marks the active stack's reachable squares; a dashed amber line connects attacker to target; a large vermillion damage numeral floats over the struck stack. Top: a horizontal initiative strip labelled "주도권 순서" with square portrait chips, the current one lifted and lit gold, spent ones faded. Right third: a parchment panel with gold borders, an attacker card labelled "공격자" and a defender card labelled "방어자", each with integer stats and a health bar. Below them a block headed "데미지 계산식" showing EXACTLY four right-aligned monospace lines of INTEGER-ONLY arithmetic, with NO decimal points, NO multiplication by fractions, NO percentages — the four lines in order are: "기본 = 마리수 x 난수피해", "천분율 = 1000 + 50 x (공-방)", "피해 = 기본 x 천분율 / 1000", "최종 피해". Every numeral in this block is a whole integer such as 1000, 1150, 243. Bottom: four ornate buttons reading "타격", "사격", "대기", "앞 한 마리". Torchlit dusk mood, uncluttered legible layout, one coherent palette.
